answers.reason: Full professors hold chairs and represent the highest academic rank, making them eligible for the central academic senate.
University-wide budget allocation is a central administrative and leadership matter above the faculty chair level.
As chairholders in the faculty, full professors are central to selecting candidates for vacant professorships.
Full professors hold a senior office in the faculty and participate in its main governing council.
Because those with higher office may take part in bodies below their level, a full professor may participate in this faculty-level teaching committee.
As a senior office holder in the faculty who teaches and supervises, a full professor is eligible to sit on the faculty's examination board.
As the leader of a research group and a senior faculty office holder, a full professor can take part in awarding internal faculty research grants.
A full professor teaches in the faculty and holds a rank that permits participation in lower-level working groups on study programmes.
As a high-ranking faculty office holder involved in teaching and research, a full professor may take part in lower-level faculty procurement decisions.
Because holders of higher office may take part in bodies below their level, a full professor is permitted to participate in lower-level faculty planning rounds.
